segments.name: Manufactured home communities
segments.description: Owns and operates manufactured home communities, leasing homesites and homes to residents, and sells and finances manufactured homes through its subsidiary S&F.
segments.evidence: The Company's primary business is the ownership and operation of manufactured home communities – leasing manufactured homesites to residents.

revenueModel.text: Residents pay the Company rent on annual or month-to-month leases for homesites and rental homes, and homebuyers pay S&F for manufactured home sales and financing.
revenueModel.evidence: Each homeowner leases the site from the Company on which the manufactured home is located.
